rca of the issue: Original bug: wa.me/?text=… without a recipient is silently ignored on iOS Safari and most Android in-app browsers (WhatsApp expects either a phone or to be opened from the contact picker). Fix: switched to api.whatsapp.com/send, which Whatsapp Web/Android handles via its picker fallback. Validated: (a) /book success href = 'https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=…I%20just%20booked…'; (b) POS invoice share opens 'https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=99999810054&text=…'. No further action.
